category: Hosted coordination service (relays + metrics + diagnostics) — NOT storage

free_tier.stated: 0 bytes of storage. Free plan = public relays in US/EU/Singapore, 7-day metrics retention, no auth, rate-limited traffic, no uptime guarantee.

retention.stated: Free plan = public relays in US/EU/Singapore, 7-day metrics retention, no auth, rate-limited traffic, no uptime guarantee

interface_detail: Dashboard at services.iroh.computer + `iroh-services` crate; account is username + email + password.
tooling: `iroh_services::Client` pushes endpoint metrics on an interval; net-diagnostics can dial back into your endpoint (requires granting `Caps::net_diagnostics_get_any()`).
chaining: Free tier covers signalling and discovery for an unlimited number of endpoints — which is exactly the part a self-hosted origin needs. It contributes nothing to bytes at rest or bytes served.
limits_note: Relay only. There is no pinning service, no blob hosting, no object storage SKU anywhere in n0's product line — the entire product is coordination plus egress.
reliability_note: Free tier requires an account only to see metrics; the relays themselves need no account at all.

evidence.proved: plan table: Free/Pro $19/Dedicated $199 per region/Enterprise; rows are Connections, Relays, Rate limit, Egress, Auth, Custom DNS, Metrics, Support. No storage row exists.
Public free / Cloud $19+ / Open Source self-host. 'Hosting' here means relays and discovery.
